spine.active_goal: Turn the plain-text Write a Note feature into a live Markdown editor with photos placed in the text, where body text wraps beside a photo on a wide screen and stacks above and below it on a narrow one. The spec is docs/specs/2026-09-20-note-editor-and-scrapbook-photos.md; its section 0 records what has shipped.

spine.last_session: Mitosis built 5 of 6 MSPs with 22 load-bearing gate verdicts; the corrupt-photo lane's Worker exited without its return line and was finished by hand with the same revert probe. Three review rounds drove on-branch fixes on every branch (draft seal, confirm-first close, preview safeguards, keyboard-aware toast, stale decode key, warm-cache bench, counting GC guard). open_risks.text: New-note draft restore never works: each composer open mints a fresh session id and looks for a draft under it, so a draft saved before a crash is written and never read back. Spec defect from the session-key stress fix; Discard already deletes the file, so any surviving draft was lost, not abandoned.

Feed preview shows every photo in its first 1200 characters instead of only the first. u2 delivered the cap; u7 rewrote its test to a photo-less note asserting findsNothing; u8 restored photo rendering without restoring the cap.

The photo mini-diagram always reports stacked, even where the reader floats the photo: rail and options sheet call planFloat without nextIsParagraph. Correct when u8 merged; u9 made planFloat actually float and introduced the drift. A test asserts the wrong behaviour.
The Add photo tile disappears when the rail's height budget drops under 72, which includes a phone in landscape with the keyboard up. There is then no way to add a photo. A test locks this in.
The format bar, and with it the Undo control, is removed entirely on short panels such as a landscape phone with the keyboard up: the exact case Undo was added for, since Android has no Ctrl-Z.
An unknown or unparseable photo placement defaults to right/medium and floats, breaking the rule that StackedPhoto is the single fallback for every failure. No test covers it.
A corrupt photo file floats: the resolver treats a blob as available when its row and file exist, not when it decodes. The test named corrupt or missing only exercises a missing reference.

EXIF orientation is never read: PhotoIntrinsics holds width and height only. A portrait phone photo may display rotated or with swapped dimensions. Not yet checked whether the engine already reports rotated dimensions.
The feed preview cuts at whitespace, and a photo line's caption and placement contain spaces, so the cut can land inside a photo token and leave a malformed line. No test covers it.

Four tests assert defects rather than the spec, so a green suite locks them in: the preview photo cap, the missing Add photo tile, the stacked-only diagram and the missing format bar. Fixing each means rewriting its test first.
CI never runs the golden images for a change to the float code: goldens.yml's path filter covers lib/design/** but not lib/features/notes/**. Local validation still runs them.

The benchmark's photo-layout numbers measure placeholder stubs, not real photos or the float: it was written before u8 and u9 existed. Its two keystroke numbers, which decide u10, measure the shipped editor correctly.
A draft store whose future never resolves still hangs a composer's discard, because the delete queues behind the pending read; pre-existing before this wave and not fixed by it.
Benchmark numbers 3 and 5 moved 26 and 41 percent at p50 between two desktop runs at different host loads; treat them as load-sensitive when comparing with the device run.
